title: Router zip cannot import the Humanus idea gate (compiled deps)
description: The router Lambda (python3.13, arm64, zip, no layers) runs monitor-stories, which imports papyrus_content.ideas.gate -> editorial_checks -> humanus. infra/monitoring/build.py --router vendors only pure-Python packages (yaml, youtube_transcript_api, requests...), so humanus is missing. Its closure also needs compiled packages: rpds-py (via jsonschema/referencing) and, for the judgment lane, typesafe-sdk -> pydantic-core. Deploying merged #966 as is would crash monitor-stories on every site. The zip test (test_the_router_zip_can_run_the_drafting_with_nothing_but_the_standard_library) does not import ideas.gate or ideas.items, so CI missed it. Fix: build the router zip with the gate's dependency closure (humanus[jev] and its deps) as wheels for the Lambda platform (manylinux aarch64, cp313), pinned to poetry.lock versions, deterministic; a build option for the host platform so the test can import ideas.gate, ideas.items and humanus.check + typesafe_sdk from the zip with -I -S. Deploy blocked on this.
